detail: Baton needs M03's brief docs/milestones/M03.md on main with a fenced block under "## Copy-ready session prompt". It is written on disk but not committed to main. A dispatch reads briefs from main and creates its worktree from main, so the session would not have the file. On main, run: git -C "@TMP@/Fixture" add -- "docs/milestones/M03.md" && git -C "@TMP@/Fixture" commit -m "Record M03 brief"
